title: Nimokkho
text: Sāvatthiyaṃ || || Atha kho aññatarā devatā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ Jetavanam obhāsetvā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antam aṭṭhāsi || || Ekam antaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Jānāsi no tvaṃ mārisa sattānaṃ nimokkhaṃ pamokkhaṃ vivekan ti || || Jānāmi khvāham āvuso sattānam nimokkham pamokkhaṃ vivekan ti || || Yathā katham pana tvaṃ mārisa jānāsi sattānaṃ nimokkhaṃ pamokkhaṃ vivekan ti || || Nandī-bhava-parikkhayā || saññā-viññāṇa-saṅkhayā || vedanānaṃ nirodhā upasamā || evaṃ khvāham āvuso jānāmi || sattānaṃ nimokkhaṃ || pamokkhaṃ vivekan ti || ||
